scores.label: A
scores.note: 1 'for cheaper wages' is an awkward collocation; 2 is passive and wordy; 5 'salaries' is the wrong word for child wages and 'for lower salaries' is ambiguous; 'than adults' is left implicit throughout

scores.label: B
scores.note: 4 'Owners liked kids' drops the hiring and reads as liking children in general, so the meaning changes; 2 drops 'factory' and frames the lower pay as a purpose

scores.label: C
scores.note: 2 drops the claim that owners liked hiring kids and states only that kids were cheaper; 3 drops the owners' motive and states only the pay gap; best option (4) is buried
